Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Planar Contagions
Module.LibraryDescription: Original planar diseases, poisons, and curses with semantic Creature Forge tags.

spark-soul-fever.Name: Spark-Soul Fever
spark-soul-fever.Description: Elemental discharges lodge in the nervous system, making muscles twitch in irregular pulses.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 electricity damage, Clumsy 1, Fatigued.

dreamdew-toxin.Name: Dreamdew Toxin
dreamdew-toxin.Description: The shimmering dew of certain fey plants numbs the body and pulls thoughts into a drowsy in-between state.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 poison damage, Stupefied 1.

ash-vein-sickness.Name: Ash-Vein Sickness
ash-vein-sickness.Description: Fine planar ash settles in the blood and heats the body from within.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 fire damage, Drained 1, Fatigued.

gloamcap-dust.Name: Gloamcap Dust
gloamcap-dust.Description: Spores from violet gloamcaps irritate the senses and cast a shadow over vision.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 poison damage, Dazzled, Stupefied 1.

axiom-tremor.Name: Axiom Tremor
axiom-tremor.Description: Contact with excessive order forces thoughts into rigid patterns and makes spontaneous action increasingly difficult.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 1d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

silverweb-venom.Name: Silverweb Venom
silverweb-venom.Description: Planar spiders carry a gleaming venom that freezes muscles into glassy rigidity.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, Clumsy 1, Slowed 1.

cinderlung.Name: Cinderlung
cinderlung.Description: Hot elemental particles settle in the airways and reignite the lungs with every breath.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 fire damage, Sickened 2, Fatigued.

whispering-halo.Name: Whispering Halo
whispering-halo.Description: A strange divine echo circles the victim’s mind, endlessly whispering impossible commandments.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 spirit damage, Stupefied 1, Frightened 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

infernal-soot-fever.Name: Infernal Soot Fever
infernal-soot-fever.Description: Soot from corrupted planes keeps burning in the lungs, consuming body and resolve.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 fire damage, Sickened 2, Drained 1.

ether-wasp-venom.Name: Ether-Wasp Venom
ether-wasp-venom.Description: The sting of ether wasps strikes flesh and soul at once, leaving behind a painful emptiness.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, 1d6 spirit damage, Slowed 1.

abyssal-ichor-toxin.Name: Abyssal Ichor Toxin
abyssal-ichor-toxin.Description: Unstable ichor from chaotic planes poisons tissue and forces it into brief, painful changes.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Clumsy 1.

moonpath-curse.Name: Moonpath Curse
moonpath-curse.Description: Those who tread a forbidden fey path later carry its shifting direction within their own mind.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 5 flat check.

astral-leech-rot.Name: Astral Leech Rot
astral-leech-rot.Description: Tiny astral leeches fasten onto life force and drain it away in subtle pulses.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 2d6 spirit damage, Drained 2, Fatigued.

lightning-marrow.Name: Lightning Marrow
lightning-marrow.Description: Elemental electricity anchors itself in the marrow and discharges anew whenever the body is strained.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 electricity damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

gravewind-pall.Name: Gravewind Pall
gravewind-pall.Description: Cold wind from dead border-realms settles over breath and blood, slowly quieting living bodies.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 void damage, Drained 2, Fatigued. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

prism-serpent-venom.Name: Prism Serpent Venom
prism-serpent-venom.Description: The venom of prism serpents carries shifting elemental charges through the bloodstream.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 2d6 poison damage, 1d6 electricity damage, Clumsy 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, 1d6 fire damage, Clumsy 2.

clock-soul-fracture.Name: Clock-Soul Fracture
clock-soul-fracture.Description: Planar mechanisms can damage a soul’s inner rhythm until thought and movement fall out of step.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 mental damage, Slowed 1, Stupefied 2. Concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

star-mold-infection.Name: Star-Mold Infection
star-mold-infection.Description: Black mold from the spaces between planes grows not only on flesh, but on perception itself.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 poison damage, Sickened 2, Stupefied 1, Drained 1.

hellglass-venom.Name: Hellglass Venom
hellglass-venom.Description: Crystal-clear drops from planar predators cut through nerves and muscles like molten glass.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1.

radiant-scar.Name: Radiant Scar
radiant-scar.Description: Excessive holy energy can leave a luminous wound in the soul that resists ordinary healing.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 spirit damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

dreaming-gate-fever.Name: Dreaming Gate Fever
dreaming-gate-fever.Description: Those who linger too long beside an open dream gate begin to confuse waking life with dreams.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 7 flat check.

void-reef-toxin.Name: Void Reef Toxin
void-reef-toxin.Description: Spines and teeth of alien reef creatures carry a toxin that draws warmth and vitality from the blood.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, 1d6 void damage, Drained 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 poison damage, 2d6 void damage, Drained 2, Slowed 1.

soul-tithe-brand.Name: Soul Tithe Brand
soul-tithe-brand.Description: A fiendish brand periodically claims a portion of its bearer’s life force as payment.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 spirit damage, Drained 2, Stupefied 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

quicksilver-time-rot.Name: Quicksilver Time Rot
quicksilver-time-rot.Description: The body slips into tiny temporal offsets, causing movement and thought to occur in slightly different moments.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 4d6 mental damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1, Stupefied 1.

elemental-concordance.Name: Elemental Concordance
elemental-concordance.Description: Conflicting elements simultaneously attempt to make the body their vessel.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 2d6 electricity damage, 2d6 acid damage, Clumsy 1.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 3d6 fire damage, 3d6 cold damage, Clumsy 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 9 flat check.

shadow-passage-rot.Name: Shadow Passage Rot
shadow-passage-rot.Description: Repeated travel through dead shadow-realms can accustom the body to the void until it begins to detach from life.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 void damage, Drained 2, Stupefied 1. You cannot speak. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

chaos-bloom-toxin.Name: Chaos Bloom Toxin
chaos-bloom-toxin.Description: Spores from an impossible bloom change their chemical form with every breath, and their effects with it.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 poison damage, 2d6 persistent mental damage, Clumsy 2, Stupefied 1.

fate-chain.Name: Fate Chain
fate-chain.Description: Invisible chains of perfect order tighten around choices, forcing possibilities into ever narrower paths.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 5d6 mental damage, Stupefied 2, Slowed 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 11 flat check. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

phoenix-ash-fever.Name: Phoenix Ash Fever
phoenix-ash-fever.Description: Living ash repeatedly ignites within the blood, leaving even healed wounds glowing with heat.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 fire damage, 2d6 persistent fire damage, Drained 2, Slowed 1. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed.

crown-of-broken-oaths.Name: Crown of Broken Oaths
crown-of-broken-oaths.Description: A broken sacred or infernal oath can manifest as an invisible crown that makes every further word harder to utter.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 spirit damage, Stupefied 2, Drained 2. You cannot speak. Damage caused by this affliction cannot be healed. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

astral-worm-colony.Name: Astral Worm Colony
astral-worm-colony.Description: Planar worms nest between body and soul and multiply where healing tries to erase their traces.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 6d6 spirit damage, 2d6 persistent bleed damage, Drained 2, Stupefied 2. You cannot regain Hit Points.

planar-unmaking.Name: Planar Unmaking
planar-unmaking.Description: The worst tears between planes can loosen a creature from its own reality, stage by stage, until nothing remains firmly anchored.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: Effects: 6d6 spirit damage, Stupefied 2, Drained 1. Concentrate actions require a DC 11 flat check.

Stage3.Name: Stage 3
Stage3.Description: Effects: 8d6 spirit damage, Stupefied 2, Drained 2, Slowed 1. You cannot regain Hit Points. Certain conditions cannot fall below their minimum value during this stage.

Stage4.Name: Stage 4
Stage4.Description: Effects: death effect, 10d6 spirit damage. You cannot speak. You cannot regain Hit Points.
